public_rationale: The claim is a conditional forecast. If an AI-linked economic debacle happens during Trump's term, he will be closely tied to it. The contract sets the window from 2025-12-12 to 2029-01-20, so the deadline has not passed. In an Anchorage Daily News report published 2026-10-25 (e1), economist Servaas Storm says there is an AI bubble in the stock market and in data center construction. He says the bubble bursting is 'not imminent, but it is approaching' and will very likely happen before Trump's presidency ends. This is one expert's forecast, not a record of a crash. The cited evidence does not show that an AI-linked crash, recession, or financial crisis has happened. It also has no polling or coverage on who would be blamed for one. The contract has no early-resolution rule. The claim cannot be scored yet.
limitations: The evidence is one news report quoting one economist. It does not measure market or economic conditions directly.

statement.excerpt: And because he has become so tight with Silicon Valley he will also be closely tied to any AI-tinged economic debacle that happens on his watch.

from_speaker: because he has become so tight with Silicon Valley

our_interpretation: 'On his watch' means during Trump's current term, ending 2029-01-20.
'AI-tinged economic debacle' plainly means a major market crash, recession, or financial crisis widely linked to AI (for example, an AI bubble bursting).
'Closely tied' would be shown by mainstream reporting and polling that link the debacle to Trump and his AI or Silicon Valley policies.
criteria.support_condition: An AI-linked economic debacle occurs before 2029-01-20, and mainstream reporting and polling widely tie it to Trump and his closeness to the tech industry.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An AI-linked economic debacle occurs before 2029-01-20, but reporting and polling largely do not tie it to Trump.
